qualification: CPU records/identities and GNU production semantics qualified; full GPU/basket timing pending

design.selection: Only ctx.circuit.permutation.ends.items.len == 0 uses disjoint fixed-position packing. Unexpected permutation records reject fail-closed.
design.storage: Caller-owned original Task allocation, no second task copy, cache, helper allocation or implicit global pool.
design.scheduler: Existing scoped row_work, minimum16384 records/shard, at most16shards; helpers join before returning any error.
design.validation: Original hint encoding and default missing-capability-query mask0xfff preserved. Capability failure is collected during fill but returned only after all packing errors, preserving original precedence.
design.csr: Original serial append/census/second capability pass remains for any graph with CSR permutations.

benchmark.input_basis: Repeated records drawn from a validated compact original-circuit fixture. This measures packing with a compact gate source, not a complete8M-operation generated circuit or full-basket time.

limits: No GPU jobs, new native image or budget used.
No production full-basket speedup extrapolated from this CPU microbenchmark.
